title: IBPS SO IT Officer 2022 — Previous Year Paper

questions.question: Statements: All routers are switches. Some switches are hubs. No hub is a modem. Conclusions: I. Some routers are hubs. II. No modem is a switch.
questions.explanation: Routers and hubs do not have a guaranteed overlap. Also modem and switch can overlap outside hubs. Neither conclusion follows definitely.
questions.subject: Reasoning

questions.question: If 'MONITOR' is coded as 'NPOJUPS', how me 'PRINTER' be coded in that same rule?
questions.explanation: Each letter is shifted forward by +1: P+1=Q, R+1=S, I+1=J, N+1=O, T+1=U, E+1=F, R+1=S -> QSJOUFS.
questions.subject: Reasoning

questions.question: In a family of six persons A, B, C, D, E, F; B is the son of C but C is not mother of B. A and C are married couple. E is brother of C. D is daughter of A. F is brother of A. How is D related to E?
questions.explanation: C is the father of B and husband of A. D is the daughter of A and C. E is brother of C. Therefore D is the niece of E.
questions.subject: Reasoning

questions.question: Point A is 10 m West of Point B. Point C is 15 m North of Point B. Point D is 10 m East of Point C. What is the shortest distance between Point A and Point D?
questions.explanation: Horizontal distance = 10 + 10 = 20 m. Vertical distance = 15 m. Shortest distance = sqrt(20^2 + 15^2) = sqrt(400 + 225) = sqrt(625) = 25 m.
questions.subject: Reasoning

questions.question: Find the missing term in the alphanumeric series: A1Z, C4X, F9U, J16R, ?
questions.subject: Reasoning

questions.question: Six people P, Q, R, S, T, U sit around a circular table facing center. P is second to left of U. Q is immediate neighbor of P and T. S is not adjacent to U. Who sits opposite to P?
questions.explanation: Arrangement clockwise: U, R, P, Q, T, S. The person sitting directly opposite to P is S.
questions.subject: Reasoning

questions.question: Statements: K >= M > N = P <= Q < R. Conclusions: I. K > P II. R > N.
questions.explanation: K >= M > N = P implies K > P (I follows). N = P <= Q < R implies R > N (II follows). Both follow.
questions.subject: Reasoning

questions.question: How many meaningful English words can be formed using 1st, 4th, 7th and 8th letters of 'DATABASE' using each letter once?
questions.explanation: 1st=D, 4th=A, 7th=S, 8th=E. Word formed: 'DATE'.
questions.subject: Reasoning

questions.question: In a code, 'packets flow fast' is written as 'ka la ma', 'fast network server' is written as 'ma pa ta', 'server flow active' is written as 'ta la ra'. What is code for 'packets'?
questions.explanation: 'fast' = 'ma', 'flow' = 'la'. Hence 'packets' = 'ka'.
questions.subject: Reasoning

questions.question: If all digits in number 8352917 are arranged in ascending order from left to right, how many digits remain in the same position?
questions.explanation: Original: 8 3 5 2 9 1 7. Ascending: 1 2 3 5 7 8 9. No position matches except wait, digit 5 is at 3rd index originally and 4th index sorted. Checking: 1(1st), 2(2nd), 3(3rd), 5(4th), 7(5th), 8(6th), 9(7th). Comparing original 8352917 with 1235789: index 7 is '7' in both (7th position). Exactly one digit ('7') stays in same position.
questions.subject: Reasoning

questions.question: Which of the following expressions shows that 'X is maternal uncle of Y'?
questions.explanation: Using standard symbol relations: X is brother of M (+), M is mother of Y (-), so X is maternal uncle of Y.
questions.subject: Reasoning

questions.question: Statements: Only a few databases are encrypted. All encrypted data is secure. Conclusions: I. Some databases are secure. II. No database is secure.
questions.explanation: Since some databases are encrypted and all encrypted data is secure, those encrypted databases are definitely secure. I follows.
questions.subject: Reasoning

questions.question: Seven projects A, B, C, D, E, F, G are scheduled from Monday to Sunday. C is scheduled on Wednesday. Only two projects between C and F. G is immediately before F. How many projects between G and A if A is on Monday?
questions.explanation: Wed=C. Two projects between C and F -> F can be Saturday (Wed+3=Sat). G is immediately before F -> G is Friday. Mon=A. Projects between Mon(A) and Fri(G) are Tue, Wed, Thu (3 projects).
questions.subject: Reasoning

questions.question: Which of the following is an external output device, unlike the internal system components?
questions.explanation: CPU, RAM, and Hard Disk are internal processing and storage hardware components. Monitor is an external output display device.
questions.subject: Reasoning

questions.question: In a certain code language, 'GLOBAL' is written as 'HMPCBM'. How is 'SERVER' written in that code?
questions.explanation: Each letter shifted +1: S->T, E->F, R->S, V->W, E->F, R->S -> TFSWFS.
questions.subject: Reasoning

questions.question: Statements: A > B >= C = D; E < F <= C. Conclusions: I. A > E II. D >= F.
questions.explanation: A > C > E => A > E (I follows). D = C >= F => D >= F (II follows). Both follow.
questions.subject: Reasoning

questions.question: A person walks 8 km South from point P, turns right and walks 6 km to reach Q. He then turns right and walks 8 km to reach R. What is distance and direction of R from P?
questions.explanation: South 8 km, West 6 km, North 8 km brings him to a point 6 km West of starting point P.
questions.subject: Reasoning

questions.question: If '+' means '÷', '-' means '×', '×' means '+', '÷' means '-', then what is value of: 36 + 6 - 3 × 8 ÷ 4 ?
questions.subject: Reasoning

questions.question: In a row of 35 students facing North, X is 12th from left end and Y is 18th from right end. How many students are sitting between X and Y?
questions.explanation: Y's position from left = 35 - 18 + 1 = 18. Students between X (12th) and Y (18th) = 18 - 12 - 1 = 5.
questions.subject: Reasoning

questions.question: Which assumption is implicit in statement: 'Install anti-virus software to protect your system from malware attacks'?
options: Malware attacks can harm system files and data.
Anti-virus software is mandatory by law.
Systems without anti-virus software never function.
Anti-virus software speeds up internet connectivity.
questions.explanation: The advice implies that malware poses a threat to systems, which anti-virus software helps mitigate.
questions.subject: Reasoning

questions.question: Five boxes J, K, L, M, N are stacked one above another. J is above K but below L. M is above L. N is at bottom. Which box is at middle position?
questions.explanation: Stack order from top: M, L, J, K, N. Middle box (3rd from top/bottom) is L.
questions.subject: Reasoning

questions.question: Select the correct combination of mathematical signs to replace * in: 24 * 4 * 2 * 3 = 15
questions.subject: Reasoning

questions.question: Complete the logical series: 7, 14, 28, 56, 112, ?
questions.explanation: Each number is multiplied by 2: 112 × 2 = 224.

questions.question: In a coding system, 'SYSTEM' is written as 'SYSMET'. How is 'KERNEL' written in that system?
questions.explanation: First 3 letters stay unchanged (KER), last 3 letters are reversed (NEL -> LEN). Result = KERLEN.
questions.subject: Reasoning

questions.question: What is the simplified value of (0.35 × 0.35 - 0.15 × 0.15) / (0.35 - 0.15) ?
questions.explanation: Using a^2 - b^2 = (a-b)(a+b), expression simplifies to (a+b) = 0.35 + 0.15 = 0.50.
questions.subject: Quantitative Aptitude

questions.question: A sum of ₹12,000 invested at compound interest doubles itself in 5 years. What will it amount to after 20 years?
questions.explanation: 20 years = 4 periods of 5 years. Amount multiplies by 2^4 = 16 times. 12,000 × 16 = ₹1,92,000.
questions.subject: Quantitative Aptitude

questions.question: A train 240 m long crosses a platform 360 m long in 30 seconds. What is the speed of the train in km/h?

questions.question: The ratio of ages of A and B 4 years ago was 4:5. 8 years from now, the ratio of their ages will be 11:13. What is present age of A?
questions.explanation: Let ages 4 yrs ago be 4x and 5x. Present ages = 4x+4, 5x+4. In 8 yrs: (4x+12)/(5x+12) = 11/13 => 52x + 156 = 55x + 132 => 3x = 24 => x = 4. A's present age = 4(4) + 4 = 20 years.
questions.subject: Quantitative Aptitude

questions.question: A tap can fill a tank in 12 hours while a drain pipe can empty it in 20 hours. If both are opened together, in how many hours will the tank be filled?
questions.explanation: Net rate per hour = 1/12 - 1/20 = (5 - 3)/60 = 2/60 = 1/30. Time required = 30 hours.
questions.subject: Quantitative Aptitude

questions.question: If 15 men can complete a software module in 24 days working 8 hours a day, how many days will 18 men take working 10 hours a day?

questions.question: A trader marks his goods 40% above cost price and allows a discount of 15% on marked price. What is his profit percentage?
questions.subject: Quantitative Aptitude

questions.question: Find the average of all prime numbers between 20 and 40:
questions.explanation: Primes between 20 and 40: 23, 29, 31, 37. Sum = 120. Average = 120 / 4 = 30.

questions.question: Two numbers are in ratio 3:5. If 8 is added to each number, the ratio becomes 2:3. What is the sum of the two original numbers?
questions.subject: Quantitative Aptitude

questions.question: What is the probability of drawing a King or a Spade from a well-shuffled deck of 52 playing cards?
questions.explanation: Number of Kings = 4, Spades = 13, King of Spades (overlap) = 1. Total favorable = 4 + 13 - 1 = 16. Probability = 16/52 = 4/13.
questions.subject: Quantitative Aptitude

questions.explanation: Milk = 70 L, Water = 10 L. New ratio required 70 / (10 + W) = 2/1 => 20 + 2W = 70 => 2W = 50 => W = 25 liters.
questions.subject: Quantitative Aptitude

questions.question: A boat travels 24 km upstream in 4 hours and 36 km downstream in 3 hours. What is the speed of the stream?
questions.explanation: Upstream speed = 24/4 = 6 km/h. Downstream speed = 36/3 = 12 km/h. Stream speed = (12 - 6)/2 = 3 km/h.
questions.subject: Quantitative Aptitude

questions.question: If 20% of a number is equal to 35% of another number, what is the ratio of the first number to the second number?
questions.subject: Quantitative Aptitude

questions.question: How many seconds will a 180 m long train moving at 54 km/h take to pass a standing pole?
questions.explanation: Speed = 54 × (5/18) = 15 m/s. Time = 180 / 15 = 12 seconds.

questions.question: A shopkeeper bought 50 articles for ₹4,000. He sold 30 of them at a profit of 10%. At what profit percentage should he sell the remaining to get overall 20% profit?
questions.subject: Quantitative Aptitude

questions.question: What is the principal amount that yields ₹1,800 as simple interest at 9% per annum in 4 years?
questions.subject: Quantitative Aptitude

questions.question: In how many different ways can the letters of word 'SERVER' be arranged?
questions.explanation: Word 'SERVER' has 6 letters with 'E' repeating 2 times and 'R' repeating 2 times. Total arrangements = 6! / (2! × 2!) = 720 / 4 = 180.
questions.subject: Quantitative Aptitude

questions.question: The sum of ages of father and son is 50 years. 5 years ago, father's age was 7 times son's age. What is father's present age?
questions.explanation: F + S = 50. 5 yrs ago: (F-5) = 7(S-5) => F-5 = 7S-35 => F - 7S = -30. Subtracting from F + S = 50: 8S = 80 => S = 10. F = 40 years.
questions.subject: Quantitative Aptitude

questions.question: A sphere of radius 6 cm is melted and recast into a cylinder of radius 6 cm. Find the height of the cylinder:
questions.explanation: Volume of sphere = Volume of cylinder => (4/3) π r^3 = π r^2 h => (4/3) × 6 = h => h = 8 cm.
questions.subject: Quantitative Aptitude

questions.question: Find the single discount equivalent to successive discounts of 20% and 10%:
questions.explanation: Single equivalent discount = 20 + 10 - (20 × 10)/100 = 30 - 2 = 28%.
questions.subject: Quantitative Aptitude

questions.question: Select the correct synonym for 'OBSOLETE':

questions.question: Select the correct antonym for 'TRANSPARENT':

questions.question: Identify the part of the sentence with a grammatical error: 'Neither the IT manager nor his team members was informed about the server maintenance.'
questions.explanation: When two subjects are joined by 'neither... nor', the verb agrees with the subject closest to it ('team members' -> plural -> 'were informed').

questions.question: Fill in the blank: 'The bank's new cybersecurity policy aims to _____ financial fraud across all digital transactions.'
questions.explanation: 'Curtail' means to reduce in extent or quantity; impose a restriction on.

questions.question: Choose the correct idiom meaning 'to fail to take advantage of an opportunity':
questions.explanation: 'Miss the bus' means to lose an opportunity by being slow to act.

questions.explanation: An auditor is a person authorized to examine and verify accounts.

questions.question: Select the correct passive voice: 'The network administrator patched the critical security bug.'
options: The critical security bug was patched by the network administrator.
The critical security bug is patched by the network administrator.
The critical security bug has patched by the network administrator.
The network administrator was patched by the critical security bug.
questions.explanation: Simple past active ('patched') becomes 'was patched' in passive voice.
questions.subject: English Language

questions.question: Select the correct indirect speech: She said to me, 'Did you complete the database migration?'
options: She asked me if I had completed the database migration.
She asked me if I completed the database migration.
She told me that did I complete the database migration.
She asked me that I completed the database migration.
questions.explanation: Simple past interrogative ('Did you complete') changes to past perfect reporting ('if I had completed').
questions.subject: English Language

questions.question: Improve the underlined part: 'He is working in this IT firm *since five years*.'
options: has been working in this IT firm for five years
is working in this IT firm for five years
worked in this IT firm since five years
questions.explanation: An action starting in past and continuing to present uses present perfect continuous ('has been working') with 'for' (duration).
questions.subject: English Language

questions.question: Fill in the blank: 'The CTO insisted _____ implementing zero-trust architecture.'
questions.explanation: The verb 'insist' is followed by the preposition 'on'.

questions.question: Select the synonym of 'METICULOUS':
questions.explanation: 'Meticulous' means taking extreme care and showing great attention to details; thorough.
questions.subject: English Language

questions.question: Select the antonym of 'LUCID':
questions.explanation: 'Lucid' means expressed clearly; easy to understand. 'Confusing' is its opposite.

questions.question: Identify error: 'Hardly had the server restarted *than* another network spike occurred.'
questions.explanation: 'Hardly' must be paired with 'when', not 'than'. It should be 'when another'.

questions.question: Fill in the blank: 'Due to unexpected server outage, the customer support team was _____ with calls.'
questions.explanation: 'Inundated' means overwhelmed with things or people to be dealt with.

questions.question: One-word substitution: 'An order prohibiting ships or trade from leaving a port.'
questions.explanation: An embargo is an official ban on trade or other commercial activity with a particular country.

questions.question: Idiom meaning: 'To leave no stone unturned'
questions.explanation: 'To leave no stone unturned' means to try every possible means to achieve something.

questions.question: Choose the correct sentence:
options: Scarcely had he left the office when it began to rain.
Scarcely had he left the office than it began to rain.
Scarcely he had left the office when it began to rain.
Scarcely did he left the office when it began to rain.
questions.explanation: Inversion 'Scarcely had + S + past participle... when' is grammatically correct.
questions.subject: English Language

questions.question: Fill in the blank: 'The new mobile banking app provides a _____ interface for senior citizens.'
questions.explanation: 'User-friendly' describes an interface designed to be easy for people to use.
questions.subject: English Language

questions.question: Antonym of 'PRAGMATIC':
questions.explanation: 'Pragmatic' means practical. 'Idealistic' is its antonym.
questions.subject: English Language

questions.question: Synonym of 'CANDID':
questions.explanation: 'Candid' means truthful and straightforward; frank.
questions.subject: English Language

questions.question: Identify error: 'Each of the software developers have submitted their project report.'
questions.explanation: 'Each of' is singular and requires the singular verb 'has submitted'.
questions.subject: English Language

questions.question: Fill in the blank: 'The server failure was attributed _____ a power surge in the data center.'
questions.explanation: The verb 'attribute' is followed by 'to'.
questions.subject: English Language

questions.explanation: The correct spelling is 'Bureaucracy'.
questions.subject: English Language

questions.question: Which SQL constraint enforces that a column cannot store NULL values and must uniquely identify each record in a table?
questions.explanation: PRIMARY KEY constraint uniquely identifies each record in a table and automatically implies NOT NULL.
questions.subject: Programming

questions.question: In Oracle SQL, which pseudo-column returns a unique sequential integer number for each row returned by a query?
questions.explanation: ROWNUM is an Oracle pseudo-column that numbers the records in a result set sequentially starting at 1.
questions.subject: Programming

questions.question: Which layer of the TCP/IP stack is responsible for IP packet routing across heterogeneous networks?
questions.explanation: The Internet layer (IPv4/IPv6) handles logical addressing and packet routing across networks.
questions.subject: Programming

questions.question: In Object-Oriented Programming (Java/C++), what is a 'Virtual Function'?
options: A function declared in base class that can be overridden in derived classes for dynamic binding
A function that cannot take arguments
A function compiled into inline assembly code
questions.explanation: Virtual functions enable runtime polymorphism by allowing derived classes to override base class implementations.
questions.subject: Programming

questions.question: Which data structure is used to convert an Infix expression into a Postfix expression?
questions.explanation: Shunting-yard algorithm uses a Stack to hold operators while converting infix notation to postfix.
questions.subject: Programming

questions.question: In Operating Systems, what is the Banker's Algorithm used for?
questions.explanation: Dijkstra's Banker's Algorithm tests for safety before granting resource allocations to avoid deadlocks.
questions.subject: Programming

questions.question: What is the key difference between a Hub and a Layer 2 Switch?
options: Hub broadcasts incoming frames to all ports, whereas a Switch forwards frames selectively based on MAC address table
Hub operates at Data Link layer while Switch operates at Physical layer
Hub supports VLAN tagging whereas Switch does not
questions.explanation: Hubs repeat signals to all ports (single collision domain), while Switches inspect destination MAC addresses and forward frames selectively.
questions.subject: Programming

questions.question: In Software Engineering, which testing technique evaluates software internal structures and code paths directly?
questions.explanation: White-Box (Structural/Glass-Box) testing tests internal code structures, branches, and execution paths.
questions.subject: Programming

questions.question: What does a 3NF relational database schema eliminate that 2NF schemas permit?
questions.explanation: 2NF removes partial key dependencies. 3NF goes further by removing transitive dependencies among non-key attributes.
questions.subject: Programming

questions.question: Which symmetric encryption standard uses 128-bit block sizes with key lengths of 128, 192, or 256 bits?
questions.explanation: AES operates on 128-bit blocks using 128, 192, or 256-bit symmetric keys.
questions.subject: Programming

questions.question: What is the worst-case time complexity of QuickSelect algorithm used for finding the k-th smallest element in an unsorted array?
questions.explanation: QuickSelect has an average time complexity of O(n) but degrades to O(n^2) worst-case with bad pivot choices.
questions.subject: Programming

questions.question: In Data Warehousing, what is a 'Star Schema'?
options: A relational schema where a central Fact table is surrounded by normalized Dimension tables
A schema where dimension tables are recursively sub-divided into further tables
questions.explanation: Star Schema consists of a central fact table surrounded by single-layer dimension tables, forming a star pattern.
questions.subject: Programming

questions.question: In Java, what is the default value of an uninitialized instance variable of type 'boolean'?
questions.explanation: In Java, primitive boolean fields are initialized to false by default.
questions.subject: Programming

questions.question: Which port number is used by default by HTTPS (Hypertext Transfer Protocol Secure)?
questions.explanation: HTTPS uses TCP port 443 by default.
questions.subject: Programming

questions.question: Which memory allocation algorithm places a process into the first free memory hole that is large enough?
questions.explanation: First-Fit allocates the first hole that is big enough during memory search.
questions.subject: Programming

questions.question: What is the output of the SQL query: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM Employees WHERE salary IS NULL ?
options: The total count of rows where salary column has a NULL value
Returns total number of all rows in table
questions.explanation: COUNT(*) counts the total number of rows matching the WHERE filter (salary IS NULL).
questions.subject: Programming

questions.question: In C language, what will happen if you attempt to access array index `a[10]` in an array declared as `int a[10]`?
options: Array index out of bounds exception is thrown at compile-time
questions.explanation: C arrays are 0-indexed (`a[0]` to `a[9]`). Accessing `a[10]` causes out-of-bounds access with undefined behavior.
questions.subject: Programming

questions.question: Which web attack tricks an authenticated user into executing unwanted administrative actions on a web application?
questions.explanation: CSRF exploits authenticated user sessions by forging unauthorized HTTP requests.
questions.subject: Programming

questions.question: What is the worst-case space complexity of a recursive Fibonacci algorithm without memoization?
questions.explanation: The maximum recursion call stack depth is n, requiring O(n) stack memory space.
questions.subject: Programming

questions.question: In Unix/Linux file permission string `rwxr-xr--`, what are the permissions assigned to the file Owner?
questions.explanation: Permissions are grouped as Owner (rwx), Group (r-x), Others (r--). Owner has rwx.
questions.subject: Programming

questions.question: Which data structure is suitable for evaluating Postfix mathematical expressions?
questions.explanation: Operands are pushed onto a Stack; when an operator is encountered, top 2 operands are popped and evaluated.
questions.subject: Programming

questions.question: In Software Development Life Cycle (SDLC), what is the primary output of the Analysis Phase?
questions.explanation: The SRS document formally specifies all functional and non-functional requirements resulting from domain analysis.
questions.subject: Programming

questions.question: What is the time complexity of searching for an element in an unsorted Singly Linked List of n elements?
questions.explanation: Searching an unsorted linked list requires traversing nodes sequentially from head to end in O(n) time.
questions.subject: Programming

questions.question: Which SQL clause is used to group rows that have the same values into summary rows?
questions.explanation: GROUP BY aggregates data based on matching values in specified columns.
questions.subject: Programming

questions.question: Which sub-protocol of IP suite is used by network utilities like `ping` and `traceroute` to diagnose connectivity?
questions.explanation: ICMP transmits control, diagnostic, and error messages such as Echo Request and Echo Reply.
questions.subject: Programming
